explication: Phoenix is a browser-focused code editor for web development. The main user flow is opening a project, editing files, and previewing the result; supporting capabilities include language intelligence, extensions, Git, remote filesystems, and an optional builder-MCP integration. The source index and excerpts support some internal links, while several subsystem connections are inferred only from the documented product scope and are marked unverified. Not every implementation path was sampled.
